title: POV
lyrics:
[whispered vocals
Deep male voice]

[Intro]
ASMR
Not too far
ASMR

[Verse]
We need more people in the movement
We got your momma and your pops and your lil' cousin
Listenin' to the crunch
And we got you hooked like that
We got you hook
Line
And sinker like that
With the clickin' and the clackin' and the
[smack] [snaps] [snap] [snap] [snap]
The clickin' and the clackin' and the crunch
And I love it
I love the look in your eye when you see us do what we do
And we love doin' what we do 'cause we love you
I mean
What better purpose is there?
I mean
The truth is we're all doin' this for the crunch
All of this is for the crunch
The crunch is our purpose
